implement_IAsyncTrainingEventHandler: implement a custom async training event handler by subclassing IAsyncTrainingEventHandler and overriding on_training_start and on_training_end
use_AsyncTrainingEventHandler: use AsyncTrainingEventHandler to handle training end events that call train_and_update_global_model on an AsyncClientDevice
test_with_TestAsyncTrainingEventHandler: test async FL training simulation by using TestAsyncTrainingEventHandler to track training events and sequence numbers
track_training_events: track training events and states by appending tuples of DeviceState and TrainingState to the training_events list
compute_seqnum_statistics: compute the mean and standard deviation of unseen global model update sequence number differences using seqnum_diff_mean and seqnum_std
